reviews.text: We have used Leo for years. He is honest, hard working and fair pricing and just nice to chit chat with. He also has showed up in a pinch on several things (ie. having a party and need to change clean day, hearing a funny sound and need him to come check it out, freeze coming and need instructions/advice on how best to protect our pool, etc.) It is so rare to find that kind of service these days. I don’t know what I will ever do if he stops doing pool service. I would hate to try to find someone

Outstanding Weekly Pool Cleaning by Mondragon Pool Service

I can't recommend Mondragon Pool Service enough for their weekly pool cleaning! From the very first visit, their team impressed me with their professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication to keeping my pool sparkling clean. They are always punctual, thorough, and genuinely care about the quality of their work.

Thanks to their consistent service, my pool has remained crystal clear and perfectly maintained without any hassle on my
I have exelent service with Mondragón pool service. I had a really experience with a bigger pool service and Mondragón Service got my pool functioning again at a reasonable price

Iam the daughter that Mr. Rivera mentions in his review the reason we stopped servicing you was because because we worked two months without you paying us an we decided to stop servicing you for that reason also plus you never wanted us to do a filter cleaner an those type of filters need to be cleaned every three months an I would ask all year around an you never approved an was needed to for your pool an would never answer the messages when needing to contact you that was the reason we stopped
I have great service with Mondragon Pool Service. I had a really bad experience with a bigger pool service and Mondragon Service got my pool functioning again at a reasonable price.
Excellent service and pool maintenance. Extremely trustworthy and reliable. Knowledge in all aspects of outdoor pool management.
He is very responsive and does great work….very happy with his service
He does my in ground pool and it stays clean and clear, great service
Leo is awesome! Great job always!
Did a good job and responsive
Very good service, professionals in their work
Excellent work, very good attitude of the staff and I really liked the kindness of Mr. Mondragon in explaining to us the care regarding our pool.

We have used Leo for years. He is honest, hard working and fair pricing and just nice to chit chat with. He also has showed up in a pinch on several things (ie. having a party and need to change clean day, hearing a funny sound and need him to come check it out, freeze coming and need instructions/advice on how best to protect our pool, etc.) It is so rare to find that kind of service these days. I don’t know what I will ever do if he stops doing pool service. I would hate to try to find someone because people/ businesses like his are so so hard find.

Side note: my husband took care of our pool for years and did a fine job but the amount of time you get back with your family by having a professional do this task is unmatched. 100% worth every penny, especially for Leo!

Thanks Leo!

I can't recommend Mondragon Pool Service enough for their weekly pool cleaning! From the very first visit, their team impressed me with their professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication to keeping my pool sparkling clean. They are always punctual, thorough, and genuinely care about the quality of their work.

Thanks to their consistent service, my pool has remained crystal clear and perfectly maintained without any hassle on my part. The technicians are friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to answer any questions I have. It’s such a relief to have peace of mind knowing my pool is in expert hands week after week.

If you're looking for reliable, top-notch weekly pool cleaning, look no further than Mondragon Pool Service — they truly deliver excellence!

data.summary: The Google reviews show strong evidence of duplication and inauthenticity. Multiple reviews are copied verbatim between the 'Local' and 'HQ' listings, and several others are very similar in structure and generic praise. The only authentic-seeming content is a detailed owner response addressing a past service termination. The perfect 5.0 score with no negative feedback and repetitive, vague language is highly suspicious.
fake_signals: Identical reviews posted on different Google listings
Multiple reviews with identical or near-identical text
Reviews lack specific details about projects or timelines
Writing style is generic and corporate-sounding in several reviews
All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
authentic_signals: One review contains a specific, detailed owner response to a past customer issue
complaint_patterns: Non-payment by customer (mentioned in owner response)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has ratings. No other platforms have data for comparison.
